page_title: SAS 3-1 VER | Sassuolo v Verona 01/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Sassuolo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+3' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!

88' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
87' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) heads on.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Armand Lauriente leaves the pitch and Uros Racic (Sassuolo) comes on.
86' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Davide Faraoni will be replaced by Filippo Terracciano (Verona).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juan David Cabal (Verona) comes onto the pitch so that Josh Doig can be given a rest.

85' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Lorenzo Montipo easily deals with the threat. Sassuolo get a corner.
85' Davide Faraoni (Verona) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Andrea Consigli was alert and made an astonishing save!
82' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
78' Alessio Dionisi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) replacing Andrea Pinamonti.
78' Substitution. Domenico Berardi is replaced by Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo).
77' Substitution. Ondrej Duda will be replaced by Milan Djuric (Verona).
77' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Lorenzo Montipo.
73' 3 - 1 Goal! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lorenzo Montipo into left side of the goal.
72' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is going to take the penalty!

72' Josh Doig (Verona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Piccinini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a penalty to Sassuolo! Let's see who's going to take it.
72' Marco Piccinini couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Uros Racic (Sassuolo) and blew his whistle. That's a free kick to Verona.
71' The foul by Josh Doig (Verona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Piccinini.
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.
69' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Matias Vina is replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo).
65' The referee signals a substitution. Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Kristian Thorstvedt.
63' 2 - 1 Goal! Armand Lauriente plays it to Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Lorenzo Montipo. 2:1.
62' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
62' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
61' 0:4 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
60' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

56' 1 - 1 Davide Faraoni sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Cyril Ngonge (Verona) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:1.
54' Josh Doig (Verona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

51' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
48' Great teamplay by Verona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Baroni probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Jordi Mboula. He is replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Verona).
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends in a cross from the free kick which goes out of play.
45+5' Today's referee Marco Piccinini rightly decides to book Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) for his harsh tackle.

45+5' Lorenzo Montipo makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
45+4' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) will deliver the corner kick.

45+4' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sassuolo.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Referee Marco Piccinini halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Marco Baroni, then shows him a yellow.
45' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

44' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
43' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
42' A yellow card for a tackle by Diego Coppola (Verona). Marco Piccinini doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
39' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
38' The ratio of the ball possession is 48:52.
36' Marco Baroni is forced to make a change. Martin Hongla is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Suat Serdar (Verona).
34' Martin Hongla (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

32' Andrea Consigli doesn't have to worry about that one. Davide Faraoni puts a cross in towards Jordi Mboula (Verona), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
29' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) for a tough tackle.
28' The resulting corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) is cleared.
27' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
26' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Cyril Ngonge (Verona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
23' One of the players from Verona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

22' Ondrej Duda (Verona) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
21' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Verona was in an offside position.
19' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

18' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Sassuolo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
16' The Verona players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
14' Marco Piccinini sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
13' Celebrations by Sassuolo are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Jeremy Toljan.
8' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
8' Josh Doig (Verona) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
6' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
5' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
4' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner with a short pass.
4' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Now Sassuolo have a corner.

3' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Lorenzo Montipo!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Verona will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Marco Piccinini was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
